'''Eggseter''' (Japanese: '''ライズタウン''' ''Rise Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive town located in [[Johto]]. The township is nestled in the Eggseter Valley located between [[Ecruteak City]] and [[Mahogany Town]].

{{pkmn|Trainer}}s flock to the town to compete in its annual [[Extreme Pokémon Race]]. Ash competed in the race featured in ''[[EP228|Extreme Pokémon!]]'', where he narrowly claimed victory over his rival {{Gary}}.

Eggseter is renowned for its clean air and open space. Many [[Pokémon Day Care]] Centers operate in the area, which raise [[Pokémon Egg]]s until they hatch, and then take care of the baby Pokémon. [[Mr. Shellby]] and his wife [[Kimie]] run the Shellby Ranch, and they gave Ash an Egg after he stopped {{TRT}} from stealing baskets of their Eggs. Ash's Egg eventually hatched into a {{TP|Ash|Phanpy}}.

==Trivia==
* Its English name appears to be a play on the English city of {{wp|Exeter}}.
